messages:
Claire: Hey team — running into preview CI flakiness on #docs-preview for PR 482. Both reviewers on rotation are OOO today. Can someone pick up reviews or approve a temporary fallback reviewer? Preview link: https://preview.redwood.ai/pr/482 :grimacing:

docs-bot: CI check 'docs-preview' failed for PR 482 — render error in migration-guide.md. See logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/482/logs :warning:

Alex: I can take it, but preview's failing for me too. Getting 502 on the preview link. @eng-sre any ideas? :raising_hand:

Mike: 502 looked like an nginx timeout. I restarted the preview job for the branch — trying now.

ci-bot: Re-run queued: docs-preview #482 (re-triggered by Mike).

Sophia: Quick look — error is from absolute asset URLs in the migration guide. The sandbox blocks cross-host asset loads so the renderer error out. Quick patch: replace absolute -> relative paths.

Sophia: Patch snippet I pushed to branch (small sed):
```bash
# make asset paths relative in migration guide
sed -i 's|https://redwood.ai/assets/|/assets/|g' docs/guides/migration-guide.md
```

Claire: can you push that quick fix? It should make preview render.

Sophia: Pushed commit 9f3a2e1 — small path fix and added a tiny docs CI check to skip known blocked externals.

ci-bot: docs-preview #482 succeeded — preview available: https://preview.redwood.ai/pr/482/rt :thumbsup: 

Alex: Preview is green and link works. I'll go through and review now.

Alex: Done — left a couple inline comments on migration steps and suggested monospace for the CLI commands.

Mike: Approved. :white_check_mark: I also updated reviewers.json to add Alex as emergency reviewer for the docs team this week (temporary).

Claire: Thank you all. I'll merge during the docs merge window at 11:30 PT and run a quick smoke check after. Tagging @product for visibility.

Product-Bot: Notified product.

Claire: Merged at 11:38 PT. All checks passed and smoke verified. Closing thread. :tada:
